size.value: 35-40mm wide, 45-50mm high (given as an acceptable range, not a single fixed size).

background.value: White background, no shadows or reflections.

expression_restriction.value: Eyes open, mouth closed, no smiling.

ears_visibility.value: Hair must not obstruct any part of the face so that both ears can be seen.

face_visibility.value: Face centered and looking straight at the camera; hair must not obstruct any part of the face. No retouching or removal of any kind from face or background.

expression.en: Eyes open, mouth closed, no smiling.
expression.ko: 눈을 뜨고 입은 다물며, 미소(웃는 표정) 금지.
expression.ja: 目を開け、口を閉じ、笑顔は禁止。

ears.en: Hair must not obstruct any part of the face so that both ears can be seen.
ears.ko: 머리카락이 얼굴의 어느 부분도 가리지 않아야 하며 양쪽 귀가 보여야 함.
ears.ja: 髪の毛が顔のいかなる部分も覆わないようにし、両耳が見えるようにすること。

face_visibility.en: Face centered and looking straight at the camera; hair must not obstruct any part of the face. No retouching or removal of any kind from face or background.
face_visibility.ko: 얼굴은 중앙에 위치하고 카메라를 정면으로 응시해야 하며, 머리카락이 얼굴의 어느 부분도 가리면 안 됨. 얼굴이나 배경에 대한 리터칭·제거 보정 일체 금지.
face_visibility.ja: 顔は中央に配置し、カメラを正面から見つめること。髪の毛が顔のいかなる部分も覆わないこと。顔や背景のリタッチ・除去修正は一切禁止。

db_conflicts.research_value: 35-40mm × 45-50mm (acceptable range per Nauru Passport Division; the DB's fixed 3.5×4.5cm sits at the minimum edge of this range, so it is compatible but not identical to the published spec)

cross_verification.note_en: Source is the Department of Justice & Border Control, Passport Division — the official Nauru government passport authority. head_height matches the DB value exactly (32-36mm = 3.2-3.6cm); size is a range whose minimum equals the DB's fixed value (see db_conflicts for detail).
